integrity: All analytical inequalities and boundary cases are supplied in RESULT.md, with independent exact-rational finite state checks in verify.py; no independent external audit or validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result applies to homogeneous independent-cascade diffusion on a fixed uniformly weighted star, zero baseline innate opinions, one equal positive shift per activated vertex, and post-cascade Friedkin–Johnsen equilibrium. The result does not address heterogeneous opinions, multiple seeds, changes to the influence graph, or transient opinions. Unindexed priority remains uncertain.
title: A sharp hub–leaf polarization reversal under viral diffusion on stars
